#
```{python}
data=data.dropna()
```
#
```{python}
rre_states=["California","Florida","Michigan","Ohio","Pennsylvania","Texas"]
rre_data=data[data["state_name"].isin(rre_states)]
rre_data.groupby("state_name")["aqi"].mean()
```
#
```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))
sns.boxplot(data=rre_data, x="state_name", y="aqi")
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
#
```{python}
rre_data_cal=rre_data[rre_data["state_name"]=="California"]
rre_data_cal.shape
```
#
```{python}
sample_mean=rre_data_cal["aqi"].mean()
sample_mean
# 12.121212121212121
```
#
```{python}
import numpy as np
sample_standard_error=rre_data["aqi"].std()/np.sqrt(data.shape[0])
sample_standard_error
# 0.43008177239994466
```
#
```{python}
me=1.96*sample_standard_error
me
```
#
```{python}
upper_limit=sample_mean+me
lower_limit=sample_mean - me
print("Confidence Interval")
print(lower_limit, upper_limit)
```
#
```{python}
from scipy import stats
stats.norm.interval(confidence=0.95, loc=sample_mean, scale=sample_standard_error)
```
